deficiencies.description: The lecturer uses pointing words ('the tumor is here', 'This is the outer surface of the uterus') to point out features on a slide, but does not state that the tumour lies next to the outer surface. The rewrite converts pointing words into an unstated spatial relation.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

deficiencies.description: The text uses the word 'circumspect', which has been replaced with 'circumscribed' in the rewrite without an entry in the corrections list.

considerations.sourcePassage: has, if you like, invaded within this tissue
considerations.reason: The phrase 'in a sense, invaded' faithfully captures the hedge 'if you like, invaded'.

considerations.sourcePassage: Movable, and literally, you can scoop it out with no damage to the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The shift from active/second-person phrasing to the passive 'the tumour is movable, and it can literally be scooped out with no damage to the surrounding tissue' preserves the full meaning.
